MAPLE HOLLOW PUBLIC LIBRARY DISTRICT
Board of Trustees

MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
September 15, 2026

CALL TO ORDER
President Janine Whitcomb called the regular meeting of the Board of
Trustees to order at 7:02 p.m. in the Community Room of the Main Library,
310 North Elm Street, Maple Hollow, Illinois.

ROLL CALL
Present: Trustees Janine Whitcomb (President), Raymond Ortiz-Bauer (Vice
President), Leah Sternfeld (Secretary), Curtis Abernathy, Mei-Lin Zhou.
Absent: Trustees Patrick Doyle, Sandra Kowalczyk.
Also present: Library Director Theresa Onyango; Business Manager Alan
Pruitt; two members of the public.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Trustee Abernathy moved, seconded by Trustee Zhou, to approve the minutes
of the August 18, 2026 regular meeting as presented. Motion carried 5-0.

PUBLIC COMMENT
A resident asked whether the branch on Fulton Road would reopen on
Sundays. The Director replied that Sunday hours depend on the staffing
plan discussed under New Business.

DIRECTOR'S REPORT
Director Onyango reported that the summer reading program enrolled 1,874
participants, up 12 percent from 2025. The roof replacement at the Fulton
Road branch is complete and came in $8,300 under budget. The library
received a state Live and Learn grant of $46,500 for digital literacy
classes.

FINANCIAL REPORT
Business Manager Pruitt presented the bills payable list for September in
the amount of $142,617.09 and the treasurer's report for August. Trustee
Ortiz-Bauer moved to approve the bills payable; seconded by Trustee
Sternfeld. Roll call vote: 5 ayes, 0 nays. Motion carried.

NEW BUSINESS
1. FY2027 Tentative Budget and Appropriation Ordinance. The Board reviewed
the tentative budget of $4.21 million. It will be placed on public
display for 30 days, and a public hearing is scheduled for 10/20/2026
before final adoption.
2. Sunday Hours Pilot. Motion by Trustee Zhou, seconded by Trustee
Abernathy, to open the Fulton Road branch on Sundays from 1:00 to 5:00
p.m. as a six-month pilot beginning November 1, 2026, funded from the
personnel contingency line. Motion carried 4-1 (Sternfeld opposed).
3. Policy on Meeting Room Use. Tabled to the next meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
There being no further business, Trustee Ortiz-Bauer moved to adjourn,
seconded by Trustee Zhou. The meeting adjourned at 8:26 p.m.

Next regular meeting: Tuesday, 10/20/2026, 7:00 p.m., Main Library.

Respectfully submitted,
Leah Sternfeld, Board Secretary
